name: Herb & Wood
menu_notes: Compared against herbandwood.com/dinner (source_url = current website page). Appetizers, Vegetables and Pizzas sections match almost to the penny (Gem Lettuce $15.31, Duck Toast $32.17, Fig & Prosciutto Pizza $33.41, etc.). Entrees and Pasta sections show a clear menu refresh since our data was captured: Half Chicken $34.73 -> now $38.73, Pappardelle -> renamed/replaced by Rigatoni at $35.45, Australian Wagyu NY Strip $83.24 -> now a USDA Prime NY Strip 14oz at $114.24, 32oz Bone-In Ribeye $180.53 -> now $200.53, and Golden Dutch Potatoes was renamed to Tuck Shop Potatoes (same $15.71 price). Several dishes are gone from the live menu: Pea Salad, Colossal Shrimp, Japanese Sweet Potatoes, Bone In Pork Chop, Grilled Swordfish, Pansotti, Summer Squash Pizza, replaced by newer items like Oak Fired Venison Strip Loin.
data_notes: Address 2210 Kettner Blvd, San Diego (Little Italy) confirmed via Yelp/Apple Maps; lat/lng (32.7272711, -117.1709958) matches Apple Maps almost exactly. Hours confirmed exact: Sun-Thu 5-9pm, Fri-Sat 5-9:30pm map correctly onto stored day rows. Restaurant is open and operating normally. Cuisine 'American' (raw 'Regional') is a loose but defensible label for what the site calls 'California Rustic Mediterranean'/New American.
issues: Entrees and Pasta sections are stale: several items renamed and priced $4-$20 below current menu
7 dishes (about 20% of 34) no longer appear on the live dinner menu at all
cuisine_raw 'Regional' is vague/unhelpful compared to the restaurant's own 'New American' / Mediterranean framing
